stack.notes: Confirmed: zero @narduk-enterprises/* runtime dependencies (grep of package.json returned no matches). Fully custom Nitro server (routes/v1, api/v1/admin, repositories/services layers) and fully custom Vue component set. Uses Nuxt UI directly, including UEmpty and UCard, which narduk-libs has no equivalent for.

local_reimplementations.notes: Raw <table> (desktop, md:block) + <ul><UCard> (mobile, md:hidden) dual-render with UEmpty empty state (line 22), formatted timestamps, an actions column. Clean reference implementation of the desktop-table/mobile-card toggle a shared table needs.

local_reimplementations.notes: Same raw-table/mobile-card dual-render pattern but at the lg: breakpoint (inconsistent with SecretMetadataList's md: -- a real breakpoint-consistency defect a shared component would fix for free). outcomeColor() maps success/denied/other to success/warning/error -- a hand-rolled status-badge color function. No UEmpty / empty-state branch found (gap vs. the other two lists).

local_reimplementations.notes: Third raw-table/mobile-card dual-render, largest of the three.

table.server_api: apps/web/server/api/v1/admin/audit.get.ts -> auditPagination() in server/utils/http/validation.ts:340 (params: cursor, limit, action, actorId, actorType, configId, environmentId, outcome, projectId, from, to -- explicit allowlist, rejects unknown query keys) -> AuditPageResponseSchema
table.notes: Client hand-rolls its own cursor-history stack (pageCursors ref array + pageIndex, lines 48-49, 161-225) to support Previous/Next over a cursor API -- exactly the state-management complexity a shared paginated-table component should absorb. PAGE_SIZE=25 constant (line 32). 3 USelect + 6 UInput filter fields (lines 269-360). No URL query-string sync found for filters/page (url_state: false) -- a real gap: filtered/paged state is not shareable or back-button-safe.

table.server_api: not directly paginated; fed by the parent config page

pagination_control.notes: Hand-rolled Previous/Next + 'Page N' label (line 392) driven by a client-side cursor stack; no page-jump/page-size control.

sort_control.notes: sortedConfigs computed; no header-click sort UI, just a fixed sort order.

filter_search_bar.notes: 3 USelect (action/actorType/outcome) + 6 UInput (actorId/configId/environmentId/projectId/from/to) filter fields, client-validated (AuditFilterError array) before the request fires.

status_chip_badge.notes: Revision UBadge in the mobile card view.

Custom account menu, not narduk-auth's AppUserMenu.

server_list_contracts.notes: server/utils/http/validation.ts:340 auditPagination() -- explicit query-key allowlist (Set of 12 names), rejects any unknown key outright, validates every value is a string. This is the single best server-side list-contract reference found across the whole lane: cursor pagination + rich filter allowlist + typed response schema.

top_extraction_candidates.name: CursorPaginatedTable (from audit/index.vue + AuditEventList.vue)
top_extraction_candidates.why: Most complete real-world reference implementation found in this survey: cursor pagination with a hand-rolled Previous/Next history stack, 9-field filter bar, loading/error states, desktop-table/mobile-card dual render, and a matching typed cursor-pagination server contract. This is close to a finished spec for the shared table's cursor-pagination mode.

top_extraction_candidates.name: Raw-table/mobile-card triad (SecretMetadataList, AuditEventList, TokenMetadataList)
top_extraction_candidates.why: Three near-identical hand-rolled desktop-table+mobile-card components (162+190+282 LOC) differing mainly in columns and one uses md: while another uses lg: for the breakpoint -- a real, fixable inconsistency. A single generic table component with column config would collapse all three.

top_extraction_candidates.name: formattedTimestamp dedup
top_extraction_candidates.why: Identical Intl.DateTimeFormat helper hand-copied into at least 2 components; trivial shared-util extraction independent of the table work.

notes: The richest table evidence in the whole lane, despite zero narduk-libs adoption. Three separate raw-table components share the same desktop-table/mobile-card shape but at inconsistent breakpoints (md: vs lg:) and with inconsistent empty-state coverage (SecretMetadataList and ConfigList have UEmpty; AuditEventList does not). The audit-log page is a near-complete hand-built spec for a cursor-paginated, filterable, loading/error-stated table -- exactly the pattern class the survey's Purpose section names first. Nuxt UI's own UEmpty is used directly for empty states rather than anything narduk-libs-provided, which narduk-libs also does not ship (AppEmptyState is narduk-core, not currently used here since there is no narduk-core dependency).
